title: How to Choose the Right Tire

seo.title: DT Swiss tire width and rim internal width reference
seo.description: Reference the DT Swiss TSS and TC tire-width to rim-internal-width matrix. Enter tire width in millimetres or inches; inch input is converted to millimetres before the published recommendation and piecewise reference calculation runs on the backend.
seo.articleBody: This page presents the DT Swiss hookless TSS and hooked TC tire-width to rim-internal-width reference. Exact widths use published rows; unlisted integer widths use piecewise linear reference calculations between adjacent data points. Possible-only rows remain references and are not model-specific certification. Inch tire widths are converted using 1 inch equals 25.4 millimetres before lookup.
seo.datasetName: DT Swiss TSS/TC tire width and rim internal width reference matrix
seo.datasetDescription: Backend-provided DT Swiss tire widths, inch labels, recommended rim internal widths, possible references, and display-only width projections.
seo.measurementTechnique: Exact published rows are read directly; unlisted widths are calculated as a piecewise linear reference between adjacent chart points.

methodology.title: Source and calculation method
methodology.unavailable: The backend reference matrix is temporarily unavailable. The page keeps the method and safety limits visible and does not substitute example calculation values.
methodology.body: Published rows are read directly; unlisted integer widths are calculated piecewise between adjacent chart rows. Inch input is only normalized to millimetres; recommendation and interpolation remain backend calculations.
methodology.version: Model version: {modelVersion}. The limitations below come from the same backend contract.

limitations.modelSpecificCertification: This is a DT Swiss reference chart result, not certification for a specific tire, rim model, or wheelset.
limitations.possibleReferenceStatus: Rows marked possible are reference anchors only; they are never relabeled as recommended.
limitations.interpolationProjection: Interpolated widths are mathematical projections between chart rows and must be checked against the exact manufacturer specifications.
limitations.displayOnlyMetrics: Inflated-width and 105% outer-width values are display-only projections, not measured dimensions or safety limits.

standards.title: Manufacturer Standards
standards.description: The following DT Swiss hookless (TSS) and hooked (TC) rim inner-width charts show recommended combinations and chart-marked possible references. The HTML tables transcribe the chart rows for search engines and screen readers; they are not certification for a specific tire or rim model. Follow the exact tire, rim, and wheel manufacturer limits.
standards.legendDescription: Recommended combinations are DT Swiss preferred pairings. Possible combinations remain chart references; they must not be relabeled as recommendations or treated as model-specific certification.
